name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.TLWE.invalid_offset_cancel
title: Error-level BGG+ encoding: the offset of invalid points cancels between two invalid points
statement: If the hidden error is itself a BGG+ encoding E_i = rho(Omega_i - x_i G) + nu_i (to make the evaluated error small exactly where the circuit value is 0), then for two circuits f1, f2 with the same value f1(x) = f2(x), the difference of the evaluated errors is rho(Omega_f1 - Omega_f2) + (nu_f1 - nu_f2): the offset f(x) rho G cancels. With rho and Omega short this is small, so differences of two invalid points pass the trapdoor's zero test (the error-level analogue of the fixed-offset attack).
